Reviewed the native HTTP and profile cache claims against the r3 source delta and callers. Unix cache publication now compares the installed path/file version with the reader starting version as well as writer generation; filesystem trust checks and Windows full reads remain. Silent response waits poll for epoch changes only before response bytes, retain deadlines, do not replay written requests, and reset their epoch after successful upload writes. The native adapter exposes network_changed as a coded TypeError through the SDK; the outbound classifier retains uncertain delivery and foreground copy offers Retry. Focused UI/SDK tests passed; Rust regressions are hosted-only and pending at this review. Existing shell, TLS and physical-device NOT_VERIFIED limits remain.
